entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For technical support, press two. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
(Sound of button mashing) Just get me a person! This is unbelievable!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, 'Alex', you can start by explaining why you sell garbage! I bought these cycling shoes two months ago and they're completely unusable! I want a full refund, now!
I'm very sorry to hear you're having a bad experience with our product. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

What's the issue? The issue is that they've given me massive blisters on every ride! I've adjusted the cleats, I've tried different socks, nothing works! They're defective! I'm about to plaster one-star reviews everywhere if I don't get my money back. This is a joke!

That sounds incredibly painful, and I apologize for the discomfort they've caused. To process a return, I just need to pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy, or can I look it up with the email address you used?
Fine. The email is angry.customer@email.com. And you better not give me the runaround or I'm demanding to speak to your manager immediately.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered 71 days ago. Is that correct?
Yeah, that's them. The instruments of torture you passed off as athletic gear.

I understand your frustration. I've reviewed your order and our policy. Since you are within the 90-day return window for this item, I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I've just initiated the return in our system.
Wait... really? Just like that? You're giving me the refund?

Yes, absolutely. We want our customers to be happy with their gear. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just pack the cycling shoes, including the cleats, back into a box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Oh. Uh... well, okay then. I didn't expect it to be that easy. So... I just print the label and send them back?
That's correct. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No... no, that's it. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
